plugins.name: jira-ticket
plugins.description: Jira ticket workspace lifecycle skill that drives the Herdr terminal multiplexer. /jira-ticket:ticket start SE-1234 opens a Herdr tab holding one orchestrator agent seeded with the ticket. /jira-ticket:ticket drive SE-1234 is the orchestrator's playbook: description audit, Jira status, on-demand agents in their own worktrees, child tickets, and a stack of draft PRs. /jira-ticket:ticket close [SE-1234] [PR#] closes out finished work: reconciles its docs, updates the Jira ticket, and tears down the worktree.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Obsidian vault workflow helpers driven by the obsidian CLI. /obs-close writes a task-closing handoff into your session log; the obsidian-vault skill defines the vault's note formats, session-log snippets, ADR and .base templates.

plugins.name: whats-up
plugins.description: Fast session orientation. /whats-up summarizes progress, remaining work, the next step and suggested follow-ups — grounded in git and todo state, not recall.
